patterns.note: High-contrast dark mode with a black background and white text, accented by vibrant orange and red for interactive elements and highlights.
Utilizes a distinctive, custom-looking display font for major headings, creating a strong brand voice, while employing a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
Asymmetrical hero section featuring a prominent text block on the left and a large, illustrative vector graphic on the right.

Large illustrative graphics in the hero section exhibit a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the main content, and feature internal path-drawing animations triggered on page load or early scroll.
Content sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and consistent two-column layouts for information like FAQs and contact forms.

technique_notes: The site establishes a high-contrast dark theme using a pure black background and white text, with bright orange and red used sparingly as accent colors for CTAs, links, and graphic details.
Custom display typography is employed for all major headings, giving the site a unique, artistic brand identity, while a highly readable sans-serif font is used for all body copy and navigation.
Large, hand-drawn style vector illustrations are integrated into the hero section, which animate their drawing paths using CSS keyframes to create a dynamic visual introduction.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold display headings (~3-4x body) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by clear, readable sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing in the hero and between sections, with comfortable line height in text blocks.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, high-contrast dark aesthetic combined with unique, animated vector illustrations that feel hand-drawn. The custom display typography for headings further reinforces a strong, artistic brand identity, making it feel less like a generic template and more like a bespoke design for creatives.
